method: Manual geometric reconstruction with photographic projection from the supplied front, side and rear photographs. Automatic photogrammetry was attempted but rejected for insufficient reconstruction quality.
orientation: glTF Y-up; base at y=0; front faces +Z after glTF conversion
revision: v3: continuous pedestal down to first step, individually jointed stone cladding, source granite photograph, corrected head width.
geometryNote: Pedestal and steps follow source silhouettes; the carved bust is an approximate continuous sculptural mesh with original photographic surface projection, not a measured facial scan.
runtimeMaterialNote: The walking viewer remaps the granite at world scale using a synthetic grain analogue (granite-grain.jpg) to avoid repeated crop seams. Plaque and sign use original photographs.
